note_evidence: The heavy distorted bass clearly ducks and pumps on every kick drum hit, especially noticeable during the sustained bass notes from 00:21 to 00:30.
beat_evidence: The track starts with a two-second vocal and riser build-up before the main funk beat drops at 00:02, delaying the clear pulse slightly.
loop_evidence: The track features a long low-pass filter fade-out from 00:35 to the end, making it unsuitable for a seamless loop.
